card.name: The word every in dosing intervals
card.fires_on: The word "every" (or "Every") right before an interval such as "4 weeks" or "2 weeks" in dosing schedules. It also fires weakly on superlative phrases like "Highest Level" or "ever gathered".

modes.label: Dosing interval
modes.description: "every" introduces a repeating schedule of weeks or days in dosing or monitoring instructions.

modes.label: Superlative phrasing
modes.description: Words completing a "highest ever" or "most ever" type claim in general web text.

card.writes: It suppresses words about rarity and happening once, such as "once" and "rare", which fits a repeating schedule.
card.plain: It marks the word "every" in repeat-dosing schedules, such as every 2 weeks.
